title: The Standing
subtitle: A scoreboard objective, asked twice
description: Two conditions on one quest, and one objective between them: the task
opens at three points of `condition_gallery_standing`, and the reward is
only paid at five. The task's condition is what the book enforces; the
reward's is checked on every claim, so collecting early is refused with
a message and collecting again later works.
Nothing in a quest file creates the objective -- a scoreboard does that,
with `/scoreboard objectives add condition_gallery_standing dummy`. The
name has no colon and does not need one: an objective is world state
rather than a registry id, and the scoreboard command takes a plain word.
An objective that does not exist reads as zero rather than as an error,
so a typo locks the gate instead of breaking the quest -- scores cannot
be checked at load, and that is the trade this example is written to show.
